outbox.title: Event outbox
outbox.description: Workspace service. Events it committed but could not publish after every retry. Replaying one resets its attempts and hands it back to the publisher.
outbox.errorTitle: The outbox could not be read.
outbox.errorFallback: Check the workspace service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
outbox.emptyDescription: No workspace event has exhausted its retries. Events still being retried do not appear here.
outbox.replayDialogDescription: It goes back to the publisher with its attempts reset to zero. If it fails again it returns to this list once those attempts run out.
outbox.replayErrorFallback: The event could not be replayed.

health.title: System health
health.description: Read back out of the metrics store, not asked of each service. A service that has lost its Redis consumer group answers its own health check with a 200.
health.errorTitle: System health could not be loaded.
health.errorDescription: Check the workspace service and that your session still holds the platform admin role.
health.monitoringUnavailableFallbackReason: The metrics store did not answer.
health.monitoringUnavailableNote: This screen is reporting that it cannot see, not that the platform is down. Nothing below is being shown as zero, because zero would be a claim. Prometheus runs on the infra host; if it is restarting, this clears on its own.
health.partialReadTitle: Part of this screen could not be read.
health.noTargets: The metrics store reported no targets.
health.noWorkers: No worker heartbeats are being reported.
health.noStageLatency: No stage has reported a latency observation.
health.footerNote: Read-only. There is no restart, no scale and no alert silencing here — this screen reports what the platform is doing, and acting on it belongs on the host.
health.noConsumerTooltip: No consumer has ever read this group
health.consumerSeenTooltip: Consumer names Redis has seen, not readers attached now
